from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, os, json, time, shutil
root=Path(__file__).parent
original=(root/'app/public/search.js').read_text()
html=(root/'app/public/index.html').read_text()
shutil.copytree(root/'replay-cache',root/'evidence/cache-baseline')
summary=[]
def restore_cache():
 shutil.rmtree(root/'replay-cache');shutil.copytree(root/'evidence/cache-baseline',root/'replay-cache')
def run(name,case,strict=False,runner='e2e'):
 restore_cache()
 out=root/'evidence'/name;env=os.environ.copy();env['E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED']='1'
 if runner=='e2e':
  cmd=['./node_modules/.bin/e2e','run','tests/agent.e2e.ts','--grep',f'^{case}$','--output',str(out),'--ai-trace']
  if strict: cmd.append('--strict-cache')
 else:
  env['PW_REPORT']=str(out)+'.json';env['PW_ARTIFACTS']=str(out)+'-artifacts'
  cmd=['./node_modules/.bin/playwright','test','--config','playwright.config.ts','--grep',f'{case}$']
 start=time.monotonic();p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=65)
 (root/'evidence'/f'{name}.log').write_text(p.stdout+p.stderr)
 row={'scenario':name,'runner':runner,'exitCode':p.returncode,'wallMs':round((time.monotonic()-start)*1000)}
 summary.append(row);print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
 (root/'evidence/ai-scenarios-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
try:
 for name,case in [('search-bug','search'),('clear-bug','clear'),('storage-bug','order')]:
  (root/'app/public/search.js').write_text((root/'evidence'/f'{name}.js').read_text())
  run('ai-'+name,case)
 (root/'app/public/search.js').write_text(original)
 (root/'app/public/index.html').write_text(html.replace('>検索をクリア</button>', '>入力をリセット</button>'))
 run('pw-label-change','clear',runner='pw')
 run('ai-label-change','clear')
 run('ai-label-strict','clear',strict=True)
finally:
 (root/'app/public/search.js').write_text(original)
 (root/'app/public/index.html').write_text(html)
 restore_cache()

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, os, json, time, hashlib
root=Path(__file__).parent
original=(root/'app/public/search.js').read_text()
mutations={
 'search-bug':('search',original.replace('row.hidden = !matchesQuery;', 'row.hidden = false;')),
 'clear-bug':('clear',original.replace('  search.value = "";\n  updateSearch();\n});', '  // 試行用: クリアを無効化\n});')),
 'storage-bug':('order',original.replace('window.localStorage.setItem(orderStorageKey, order.value);', '// 試行用: 保存を無効化'))
}
summary=[]
try:
 for name,(case,mutant) in mutations.items():
  assert mutant != original
  (root/'app/public/search.js').write_text(mutant)
  (root/'evidence'/f'{name}.js').write_text(mutant)
  for runner in ['pw','e2e']:
   out=root/'evidence'/f'{runner}-{name}'
   env=os.environ.copy();env['E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED']='1'
   if runner=='pw':
    env['PW_REPORT']=str(out)+'.json';env['PW_ARTIFACTS']=str(out)+'-artifacts'
    cmd=['./node_modules/.bin/playwright','test','--config','playwright.config.ts','--grep',f'^{case}$']
   else: cmd=['./node_modules/.bin/e2e','run','tests/deterministic.e2e.ts','--grep',f'^{case}$','--output',str(out)]
   start=time.monotonic()
   p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=70)
   row={'scenario':name,'runner':runner,'exitCode':p.returncode,'wallMs':round((time.monotonic()-start)*1000),'mutantSha256':hashlib.sha256(mutant.encode()).hexdigest()}
   (root/'evidence'/f'{runner}-{name}.log').write_text(p.stdout+p.stderr)
   summary.append(row); print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
finally:
 (root/'app/public/search.js').write_text(original)
 (root/'evidence/mutations-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))

 'storage-bug':('order',original.replace('window.localStorage.setItem(orderStorageKey, order.value);', '// 試行用: 保存を無効化'))
}
summary=[]
try:
 for name,(case,mutant) in mutations.items():
  assert mutant != original
  (root/'app/public/search.js').write_text(mutant)
  (root/'evidence'/f'{name}.js').write_text(mutant)
  for runner in ['pw']:
   out=root/'evidence'/f'{runner}-v2-{name}'

   else: cmd=['./node_modules/.bin/e2e','run','tests/deterministic.e2e.ts','--grep',f'{case}$','--output',str(out)]
   start=time.monotonic()
   p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=70)
   row={'scenario':name,'runner':runner,'exitCode':p.returncode,'wallMs':round((time.monotonic()-start)*1000),'mutantSha256':hashlib.sha256(mutant.encode()).hexdigest()}
   (root/'evidence'/f'{runner}-v2-{name}.log').write_text(p.stdout+p.stderr)
   summary.append(row); print(json.dumps(row),flush=True)
finally:
